say:1:1630429001:1.text: He's fixing my little house! Woof!
say:1:1630429001:1.source_cn: 他正在修我的小木屋！汪！
say:1:1630429001:1.male: He's fixing my little house! Woof!
say:1:1630429001:1.female: He's fixing my little house! Woof!

say:2:1630429002:1.text: He kind of... smashed it by accident yesterday. And my leash went down with it, so now I can run free! Lucky me!
say:2:1630429002:1.source_cn: 主人昨天不小心把我的木屋砸坏了。没有了拴着我的屋子，今...
say:2:1630429002:1.male: He kind of... smashed it by accident yesterday. And my leash went down with it, so now I can run free! Lucky me!
say:2:1630429002:1.female: He kind of... smashed it by accident yesterday. And my leash went down with it, so now I can run free! Lucky me!

choice_prompt:3:1630429002.text: He kind of... smashed it by accident yesterday. And my leash went down with it, so now I can run free! Lucky me!
choice_prompt:3:1630429002.source_cn: 主人昨天不小心把我的木屋砸坏了。没有了拴着我的屋子，今天我才能跑到稻田这里玩。
choice_prompt:3:1630429002.male: He kind of... smashed it by accident yesterday. And my leash went down with it, so now I can run free! Lucky me!
choice_prompt:3:1630429002.female: He kind of... smashed it by accident yesterday. And my leash went down with it, so now I can run free! Lucky me!

say:4:1630429003:1.text: Oh, don't worry! My human loves me very, very much!
say:4:1630429003:1.source_cn: 哦，请不要怀疑！我的主人绝对爱我！
say:4:1630429003:1.male: Oh, don't worry! My human loves me very, very much!
say:4:1630429003:1.female: Oh, don't worry! My human loves me very, very much!

say:5:1630429004:1.text: That was just a whoopsie. He's incredibly clumsy, like, even more than me.
say:5:1630429004:1.source_cn: 那只是一个意外。他真的很笨手笨脚，比我还要笨。
say:5:1630429004:1.male: That was just a whoopsie. He's incredibly clumsy, like, even more than me.
say:5:1630429004:1.female: That was just a whoopsie. He's incredibly clumsy, like, even more than me.

say:6:1630429005:1.text: I'm a little smarter than him, which makes us a perfect pair. He needed me.
say:6:1630429005:1.source_cn: 我比他要聪明一点儿，所以他刚好适合收养我。
say:6:1630429005:1.male: I'm a little smarter than him, which makes us a perfect pair. He needed me.
say:6:1630429005:1.female: I'm a little smarter than him, which makes us a perfect pair. He needed me.

say:7:1630429006:1.text: Besides, I'm so happy! I finally got to come out and play all by myself!
say:7:1630429006:1.source_cn: 而且我很开心——我终于能自己跑出来玩啦！
say:7:1630429006:1.male: Besides, I'm so happy! I finally got to come out and play all by myself!
say:7:1630429006:1.female: Besides, I'm so happy! I finally got to come out and play all by myself!

say:8:1630429007:1.text: I just hope no one ever tells him he's too clumsy to keep me... That would be awful.
say:8:1630429007:1.source_cn: 不过我真的很害怕有一天他会因为过于笨手笨脚而被禁止收养...
say:8:1630429007:1.male: I just hope no one ever tells him he's too clumsy to keep me... That would be awful.
say:8:1630429007:1.female: I just hope no one ever tells him he's too clumsy to keep me... That would be awful.
